turns.text: Yeah, even though it's summer, as head of the science department there's always prep work to do. I have to go in to check on some inventory and lab supplies. But before that, I'm squeezing in a workout—I'm doing some gym weights this morning.

turns.text: I imagine! It sounds like you'll both need a low-key evening to unwind. Any plans for tonight, or just relaxing?

turns.text: Definitely just relaxing. I think we're just going to put on some sitcom reruns tonight and turn our brains off for a bit.

turns.text: Sitcom reruns are perfect for that. Nothing beats a familiar, easy laugh after a hectic day. I hope Olive joins you guys on the couch for some cuddle time.
